{{Quote|Anyone that gets it done gets double hazard pay. We ID'd the Mando commander as Duran Gorr&mdash;the guy takes down Jedi for his day job, so expect major opposition.|Major [[Teranos]]'s posting on Gorr's group|<ref name="Fallen" />}}
'''Duran Gorr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] raider who lived doing the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He led a group of Mandalorians that raided a shipment of Republic warheads. However, both he and his men were killed by Republic forces who came for the warheads. Duran Gorr wore [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] with [[Color/Legends|white]] markings, and bone-like tattoos on his face.<ref name="Fallen" />

==Behind the scenes==
Duran Gorr appears in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the final enemy in the Heroic mission "Fallen Stars" on Taris for Republic players.<ref name="Fallen" />
